_meta.outcome: meeting_fixed on answered VANI bot calls, Apr-Sep 2026

new_seller.claim: Sellers GST-registered in 2024 or later fix meetings more often: open warmly and explain the benefit.

high_turnover.claim: Sellers with turnover >= 1.5 Cr fix fewer meetings and hang up sooner: be concise, more formal, value-first.

limited_company.claim: Limited companies fix fewer meetings than proprietorships: more formal register.

past_frustration.claim: Sellers who showed frustration before fix fewer meetings: calm, slower, apologetic, offer a callback early.
past_frustration.caveat: Flag summarizes the same Apr-Sep calls; includes the call where it was raised.

asked_if_bot.claim: Sellers who asked if they were talking to a bot: say up front that this is IndiaMART's AI assistant.
asked_if_bot.caveat: Flag summarizes the same Apr-Sep calls; includes the call where it was raised.

already_in_touch.claim: Sellers already in touch with an executive fix fewer meetings and talk longer: acknowledge it first.
already_in_touch.caveat: Flag summarizes the same Apr-Sep calls; includes the call where it was raised.

do_not_call.claim: Sellers who asked not to be called almost never fix meetings: suppress the call (policy, not persona).
do_not_call.caveat: Flag summarizes the same Apr-Sep calls; includes the call where it was raised.

short_call_history.claim: Sellers whose earlier calls averaged < 25 s hang up early again: shorten turns and get to the point fast.

prior_call_later.claim: Sellers who said 'call later' before: reference the callback and ask for a time early.

prior_not_interested.claim: Sellers who said 'not interested' before: short, low-pressure, give one reason then offer to end.

first_call.claim: First answered call to a seller (no prior history): default settings; live adaptation corrects them.

personalised_trial.claim: The personalised-script trial fixed more meetings than other versions on the same days: personalise the opening.
personalised_trial.source: bot calls, lead_bot_version on trial days
personalised_trial.caveat: Not randomized; ran on few days. Treat as a hint, not proof.

language_by_state.claim: Share of transcribed calls where the seller spoke mostly English, by state (>= 100 calls).
language_by_state.caveat: Transcript subset over-represents meetings; romanized text, so regional languages are undercounted.

language_by_business_type.claim: Limited companies lean English slightly more often than proprietorships.

price_inconsistency.claim: Today's VANI states different prices on different calls: personas never state prices; the executive does.

identity_drop.claim: 17.3% of evaluated calls drop right after the IndiaMART / identity moment and 25.2% never respond: keep the first turn short, check the line, and state purpose and benefit together.

bot_latency.claim: Calls where the bot's median reply lag is <= 1.5 s fix ~25% vs 4.6% above 3 s: adaptation must add no delay.
bot_latency.caveat: Correlational; long lag also follows long seller turns.

voice_gender.claim: VANI has always used one female voice ('Payal ... bol rahi hoon'); no data compares genders.

voice_speaker.claim: Speaker per language follows Sarvam's quality ranking; tone-to-speaker mapping is a design choice.

pitch.claim: No pitch variation exists in past calls.
